G101.def: from «102»; to be unable, i.e. (passively) impossible:--be impossible.

G102.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «1415»; unable, i.e. weak (literally or figuratively); passively, impossible:--could not do, impossible, impotent, not possible, weak.

G104.et: from an obsolete primary noun (apparently meaning continued duration)
G104.def: from an obsolete primary noun (apparently meaning continued duration); "ever,"by qualification regularly; by implication, earnestly; --always, ever.

G105.def: from the same as «109»; an eagle (from its wind-like flight):--eagle.

G106.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «2219»; unleavened, i.e. (figuratively) uncorrupted; (in the neutral plural) specially (by implication) the Passover week:--unleavened (bread).

G107.def: of Hebrew origin (compare «05809»); Azor, an Israelite:--Azorigin

G108.def: of Hebrew origin («0795»); Azotus (i.e. Ashdod), a place in Palestine:--Azotus.

G109.et: from aemi (to breathe unconsciously, i.e. respire; by analogy, to blow)
G109.def: from aemi (to breathe unconsciously, i.e. respire; by analogy, to blow); "air" (as naturally circumambient):--air. Compare «5594».

G110.et: from a compound of (1) (as a negative particle) and (2288)
G110.def: from a compound of «1» (as a negative particle) and «2288»; deathlessness:--immortality.

G111.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of themis (statute, from the base of (5087))
G111.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of themis (statute; from the base of «5087»); illegal; by implication, flagitious:--abominable, unlawful thing.

G112.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «2316»; godless:--without God.

G113.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (5087) (in the sense of enacting)
G113.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «5087» (in the sense of enacting); lawless, i.e. (by implication) criminal:--wicked.

G114.et: from a compound of (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (5087)
G114.def: from a compound of «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «5087»; to set aside, i.e. (by implication) to disesteem, neutralize or violate:--cast off, despise, disannul, frustrate, bring to nought, reject.

G115.def: from «114»; cancellation (literally or figuratively):--disannulling, put away.

G116.et: plural of Athene (the goddess of wisdom, who was reputed to have founded the city)
G116.def: plural of Athene (the goddess of wisdom, who was reputed to have founded the city); Athenoe, the capitol of Greece:-- Athens.

G117.def: from «116»; an Athenoean or inhabitant of Athenae:--Athenian.

G118.et: from athlos (a contest in the public lists)
G118.def: from athlos (a contest in the public lists); to contend in the competitive games:--strive.

G120.et: from a compound of (1) (as a negative particle) and (2372)
G120.def: from a compound of «1» (as a negative particle) and «2372»; to be spiritless, i.e. disheartened:--be dismayed.

G121.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and probably a derivative of (5087) (meaning a penalty)
G121.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and probably a derivative of «5087» (meaning a penalty); not guilty:--innocent.

G122.def: from aix (a goat); belonging to a goat:--goat.

G123.et: from aisso (to rush) and (251) (in the sense of the sea)
G123.def: from aisso (to rush) and «251» (in the sense of the sea; a beach (on which the waves dash):--shore.

G124.def: from «125»; an Ægyptian or inhabitant of Ægyptus:--Egyptian.

G125.def: of uncertain derivation:--Ægyptus, the land of the Nile:--Egypt.

G126.def: from «104»; everduring (forward and backward, or forward only):--eternal, everlasting.

G127.et: perhaps from (1) (as a negative particle) and (1492) (through the idea of downcast eyes)
G127.def: perhaps from «1» (as a negative particle) and «1492» (through the idea of downcast eyes); bashfulness, i.e. (towards men), modesty or (towards God) awe:--reverence, shamefacedness.

G128.et: from aitho (to scorch) and ops (the face, from (3700))
G128.def: from aitho (to scorch) and ops (the face, from «3700»); an Æthiopian (as a blackamoor):--Ethiopian.

G129.def: of uncertain derivation; blood, literally (of men or animals), figuratively (the juice of grapes) or specially (the atoning blood of Christ); by implication, bloodshed, also kindred:--blood.

G130.def: from «129» and a derivative of «1632»; an effusion of blood:--shedding of blood.

G131.def: from «129» and «4482»; to flow blood, i.e. have a hoemorrhage:--diseased with an issue of blood.

G132.def: of uncertain derivation; Aeneas, an Israelite:--Aeneas.

G133.def: from «134»; a praising (the act), i.e. (specially) a thank(-offering):--praise.

G135.et: from a derivative of (136) (in its primary sense)
G135.def: from a derivative of «136» (in its primary sense); an obscure saying ("enigma"), i.e. (abstractly) obscureness:--X darkly.

G136.et: apparently a primary word, properly, a story, but used in the sense of (1868)
G136.def: apparently a prime word; properly, a story, but used in the sense of «1868»; praise (of God):--praise.

G137.et: of Hebrew origin, a derivative of (05869)
G137.def: of Hebrew origin (a derivative of «5869», place of springs); Ænon, a place in Palestine:--Ænon.

G138.def: probably akin to «142»; to take for oneself, i.e. to prefer:--choose. Some of the forms are borrowed from a cognate hellomai hel'-lom-ahee; which is otherwise obsolete.

G139.def: from «138»; properly, a choice, i.e. (specially) a party or (abstractly) disunion:--heresy (which is the Greek word itself), sect.

G140.def: from a derivative of «138»; to make a choice:--choose.

G141.def: from the same as «140»; a schismatic:--heretic (the Greek word itself).

G142.def: a primary root; to lift up; by implication, to take up or away; figuratively, to raise (the voice), keep in suspense (the mind), specially, to sail away (i.e. weigh anchor); by Hebraism (compare «05375») to expiate sin:--away with, bear (up), carry, lift up, loose, make to doubt, put away, remove, take (away, up).

G143.def: of uncertain derivation; to apprehend (properly, by the senses):--perceive.

G145.def: from a derivative of «143»; properly, an organ of perception, i.e. (figuratively) judgment:--senses.

G146.def: from «150» and kerdos (gain); sordid:--given to (greedy of) filthy lucre.

G147.def: adverb from «146»; sordidly:--for filthy lucre's sake.

G149.def: neuter of «150»; a shameful thing, i.e. indecorum:--shame.

G150.def: from the same as «153»; shameful, i.e. base (specially, venal):--filthy.

G152.def: from «153»; shame or disgrace (abstractly or concretely):--dishonesty, shame.

G153.def: from aischos (disfigurement, i.e. disgrace); to feel shame (for oneself):--be ashamed.

G154.def: of uncertain derivation; to ask (in genitive case):--ask, beg, call for, crave, desire, require. Compare «4441».

G155.def: from «154»; a thing asked or (abstractly) an asking:--petition, request, required.

G156.def: from the same as «154»; a cause (as if asked for), i.e. (logical) reason (motive, matter), (legal) crime (alleged or proved):--accusation, case, cause, crime, fault, (wh-)ere(-fore).

G157.def: from a derivative of «156»; a thing charged:--complaint.

G158.def: neuter of «159»; a reason or crime (like «156»):--cause, fault.

G159.def: from the same as «154»; causative, i.e. (concretely) a causer:--author.

G160.et: from a compound of (1) (as a negative particle) and (5316) [cf (1810)]
G160.def: from a compound of «1» (as a negative particle) and «5316» (compare «1810») (meaning non-apparent); unexpected, i.e. (adverbially) suddenly:--sudden, unawares.

G163.def: from «164»; to make captive:--lead away captive, bring into captivity.

G164.et: from aichme (a spear) and a derivative of the same as (259)
G164.def: from aichme (a spear) and a derivative of the same as «259»; properly, a prisoner of war, i.e. (genitive case) a captive:--captive.

G165.def: from the same as «104»; properly, an age; by extension, perpetuity (also past); by implication, the world; specially (Jewish) a Messianic period (present or future):--age, course, eternal, (for) ever(-more), (n-)ever, (beginning of the , while the) world (began, without end). Compare «5550».

G166.def: from «165»; perpetual (also used of past time, or past and future as well):--eternal, for ever, everlasting, world (began).

G167.def: from «169»; impurity (the quality), physically or morally:--uncleanness.

G169.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (2508) (meaning cleansed)
G169.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «2508» (meaning cleansed); impure (ceremonially, morally (lewd) or specially, (demonic)):--foul, unclean.

G170.et: from a compound of (1) (as a negative particle) and (2540) (meaning unseasonable)
G170.def: from a compound of «1» (as a negative particle) and «2540» (meaning unseasonable); to be inopportune (for oneself), i.e. to fail of a proper occasion:--lack opportunity.

G171.def: adverb from the same as «170»; inopportunely:--out of season.

G172.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «2556»; not bad, i.e. (objectively) innocent or (subjectively) unsuspecting:--harmless, simple.

G173.def: probably from the same as «188»; a thorn:--thorn.

G175.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «2590»; barren (literally or figuratively):--without fruit, unfruitful.

G176.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (2607)
G176.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «2607»; unblamable:--that cannot be condemned.

G177.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and (2619) a derivative of a compound of (2596) and (2572)
G177.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of «2596» and «2572»; unveiled:--uncovered.

G178.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (2632)
G178.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «2632»; without (legal) trial:--uncondemned.

G179.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (2647)
G179.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «2647»; indissoluble, i.e. (figuratively) permanent:--endless.

G180.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (2664)
G180.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «2664»; unrefraining:--that cannot cease.

G181.def: from «182»; instability, i.e. disorder:--commotion, confusion, tumult.

G182.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (2525)
G182.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «2525»; inconstant:--unstable.

G183.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of (2722)
G183.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a derivative of «2722»; unrestrainable:--unruly.

G184.def: of Chaldee origin (meaning field of blood; corresponding to «02506» and «01818»); Akeldama, a place near Jerusalem:--Aceldama.

G185.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (2767)
G185.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «2767»; unmixed, i.e. (figuratively) innocent:--harmless, simple.

G186.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «2827»; not leaning, i.e. (figuratively) firm:--without wavering.

G187.def: from the same as «188»; to make a point, i.e. (figuratively) mature:--be fully ripe.

G188.et: accusative case of a noun ("acme") akin to ake (a point) and meaning the same
G188.def: accusative case of a noun ("acme") akin to ake (a point) and meaning the same; adverbially, just now, i.e. still:--yet.

G189.def: from «191»; hearing (the act, the sense or the thing heard):--audience, ear, fame, which ye heard, hearing, preached, report, rumor.

G190.et: from (1) (as a particle of union) and keleuthos (a road)
G190.def: from «1» (as a particle of union) and keleuthos (a road); properly, to be in the same way with, i.e. to accompany (specially, as a disciple):--follow, reach.

G191.def: a primary verb; to hear (in various senses):--give (in the) audience (of), come (to the ears), (shall) hear(-er, -ken), be noised, be reported, understand.

G193.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and «2904»; powerless, i.e. without self-control:--incontinent.

G194.et: from (1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of (2767)
G194.def: from «1» (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of «2767»; undiluted:--without mixture.

G195.def: from the same as «196»; exactness:--perfect manner.

G196.et: superlative of akribes (a derivative of the same as (206))
G196.def: superlative of akribes (a derivative of the same as «206»); most exact:--most straitest.

G197.et: neuter of the comparative of the same as (196)
G197.def: neuter of the comparative of the same as «196»; (adverbially) more exactly:--more perfect(-ly).

G198.def: from the same as «196»; to be exact, i.e. ascertain:--enquire diligently.

G199.def: adverb from the same as «196»; exactly:--circumspectly, diligently, perfect(-ly).
